string.name: photopicker_selection_max_media_item_size_error_kb
string.translation_description: Error message shown when the user tries to select a file that is larger than the maximum allowed size. %1$s is the app name. %2$s is the maximum size in KB.

resources.string: %1$s requires photos and videos to be smaller than %2$s KB

string.name: photopicker_selection_max_video_duration_error

string.name: photopicker_selection_unsupported_mime_type_error
string.translation_description: Error message shown when the user tries to select a file with a mime type that is not supported by the calling app. %1$s is the app name.

string.name: photopicker_selection_max_selection_batch_size_error_kb

resources.string: %1$s requires the total file size to be smaller than %2$s KB

string.name: photopicker_selection_param_generic_app_label
string.translation_description: A generic identifier of an application that is used in place of the name of the app if one is not defined or can not be fetched.
